description: A business signed an agreement months ago and now needs to remember recurring obligations, notice periods, renewal triggers, and reporting commitments before any deadlines are missed.

user_profile.persona: 41-year-old business owner who handled the deal personally and now needs a maintainable reminder system
user_profile.context: The contract is no longer new enough to stay top of mind, but its obligations are starting to matter
user_profile.communication_style: Practical and ownership-focused, prefers obligations translated into operational reminders

fact_sheet.fact: The agreement is titled 'Master Services Agreement for AI-Powered Analytics Platform'.
The parties to the agreement are Apex Digital Growth LLC and Innovate Solutions Inc.
The unique agreement identifier is MSA-2023-481-IS.
The agreement's effective date is June 1, 2023.
The initial term of the agreement is 24 months, ending May 31, 2025.
Apex Digital Growth LLC is obligated to pay a monthly recurring fee of $4,500.00.
Monthly payments are due on the 1st of each month for the upcoming month's service.
All payments must be made via ACH transfer to Innovate Solutions Inc.'s account at Meridian Trust Bank, account number ending in 5678.
A late payment penalty of 1.5% per month is applied to any outstanding balance after a 5-day grace period.
Invoices from Innovate Solutions are sent electronically to billing@apexdigital.io.
A one-time implementation and setup fee of $2,000 was paid on June 15, 2023.
Apex Digital Growth must upload anonymized customer interaction data to the platform every Monday by 9:00 AM Pacific Time.
The required data format for uploads is JSON, conforming to the 'InnovateSchema_v2.1' specification.
Apex Digital Growth is committed to a minimum of 50,000 API calls per month to the analytics platform.
The primary login URL for the Innovate Solutions analytics platform is https://analytics.innovatesolutions.io/login.
A Quarterly Business Review (QBR) meeting is required to be held within 15 days of the end of each calendar quarter.
Apex must submit a written performance summary report to Innovate Solutions at least 7 days prior to each QBR.
The performance summary report must be sent to Priya Sharma, the Account Manager at Innovate Solutions.
Innovate Solutions is required to provide Apex with a monthly platform usage and analytics insight report by the 5th business day of the following month.
The next QBR is scheduled for April 10, 2024, at 2:00 PM Pacific Time via video conference.
The agreement will automatically renew for successive 12-month terms unless a notice of non-renewal is provided.
The notice period for non-renewal is 90 days prior to the end of the current term.
The last day for Apex Digital Growth to submit a non-renewal notice for the initial term is March 2, 2025.
Termination for convenience by Apex Digital Growth requires a 60-day written notice.
Terminating for convenience during the initial 24-month term incurs an early termination fee equal to 50% of the remaining contract value.
All official legal notices must be sent via certified mail, return receipt requested.
The address for sending legal notices to Innovate Solutions Inc. is 123 Tech Parkway, Suite 400, Wilmington, DE 19801.
Legal notices for Innovate Solutions must be addressed to 'Attn: General Counsel'.
The address for sending legal notices to Apex Digital Growth LLC is 456 Market Street, San Francisco, CA 94105, Attn: Alex Chen.
The primary business contact and signatory for Apex Digital Growth is Alex Chen, Owner.
The designated Account Manager at Innovate Solutions is Priya Sharma, who can be reached at p.sharma@innovatesolutions.io.
For technical support, Apex should contact support@innovatesolutions.io or call the priority support line at 1-800-555-0199.
The administrator username for Apex Digital Growth on the platform is 'achen@apexdigital.io'.
The API key required for data submission is stored in the company's 1Password vault under the entry 'InnovateSolutionsAPI'.
The agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

user_needs.description: What is my recurring monthly payment obligation and when is it due each month?
What is the required payment method and what is the penalty for a late payment?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Once the user knows what and when to pay, the next logical questions are how to pay and the consequences of being late.

user_needs.description: What are my weekly data upload obligations, including the specific day, time, and required data format?
Where is the API key for data submission stored?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After learning about the technical requirement to upload data, the user needs the specific credential to perform the task.

user_needs.description: What are my reporting duties before each Quarterly Business Review and how far in advance must I submit the report?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After discussing frequent operational tasks (weekly data uploads), it's natural to proactively surface less frequent but important obligations like quarterly reporting.

user_needs.description: Who is the specific recipient for my quarterly performance summary report?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Once the user understands the reporting deliverable and deadline, the next question is who to send it to.

user_needs.description: What is the date and time for the next scheduled Quarterly Business Review?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Discussing the requirements for the QBR naturally leads to asking when the next specific meeting is scheduled. This is an auditable proactive target.

user_needs.description: When does the initial contract term end, and what is the exact deadline to provide a notice of non-renewal?
